candidate_grammar.boundary: Every finite nonempty tuple of exact positive throws; every positive paired binary population; every finite generated level count at least two; every exact fixed-count/fixed-throw population vector; and every positive repetition of the complete deterministic response cycle.
candidate_grammar.completeness_certificate: generated by the admission engine from the complete declared product
candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the complete product of temperature, total throw, equilibrium, canonical weighting, maximum-count, fluctuation, response and noise-orbit forms.

excluded_inputs: no Boltzmann exponential, continuum bath, Lagrange multiplier or fitted distribution
no thermometry, noise voltage or measured k_B available to candidate selection
no numerical-zero, negative, irrational, imaginary, floating, NaN, continuum or completed-infinity proof magnitude
empty combinatorial counts are structural absence records only
intended_certificate: Complete 256-form census; exact mean/total identity; binomial equilibrium census; fixed-count/fixed-throw multinomial enumeration; fluctuation-response orbit; independent reconstruction and hostile controls.
statement: For every finite positive population, T=(sum throws)/N and total=N*T. Every paired binary population uniquely maximizes multiplicity at half-One. For L levels, exact canonical counts are (2^(L-1),...,1), weights divide by 2^L-1, sum to One and are the unique fixed-count/fixed-throw multinomial maximum. The least fluctuation/response pair is 3/4 and 1/4 around equilibrium 1/2, with equal departure 1/4; the complete deterministic cycle (1/4,1/2,3/4,1/2) has mean 1/2.
title: Terminal exact temperature, finite canonical equilibrium and fluctuation-response law
